emailProofExchange.boundary: proofId is an internal reference after authenticated token exchange; never a bearer secret in notifications

otpHook.boundary: signature/freshness/shared abuse limits validated by trusted adapter; no sends in reference

notification.recipient: opaque server-side resolver reference; never raw contact or token
notification.content: only reviewed generic template; no free text or health/history payload

providerReceipt.boundary: Authenticated evidence whose outcome, key and attempt exactly equal the receipt; never a browser callback or relabelled timeout.

trustedProofRecord.boundary: Internal trusted store fixture only; historical emailVerifiedAt precedes risk, current challengeCompleted is true and proofCompletedAt is at/after risk and at/before now. Not an HTTP input.

obligations.requirement: Atomically consume an authenticated proof once for exact account, purpose, operation and unique verified email. Risk/number change requires email verified before risk. Reject missing/unverified/shared/newly verified email and expired/replayed/cross-bound proof.

Trusted fresh signed OTP hook and shared quotas/cooldown/attempt/spend policy before provider boundary; duplicate hook no effect. Provider failure never authenticates. Preserve non-enumeration and no victim lockout.

Transactional outbox dedup on event/channel/recipient; bind payload fingerprint and attempt. Unknown outcome blocks retries until authenticated reconciliation. Confirmed no-send alone permits bounded retries. Sent is terminal.
Push requires current opt-in and current installation/session/account binding at send time; revoked association denies. No consent inferred from other channels.
Renewal_due reads actual authoritative version/state; no cancelled/opted-out/trial/invalid-mandate/no-versioned-acceptance renewal claim.
Admission at launch requires explicit manual authorized dispatch; automatic transactional handling does not override D-016.

Exact notification allowlist and reviewed FR/EN template only; reject raw contact/OTP/token/health/history/free text and unrecognized locale/version. Generic content, authenticated owner retrieval outside notification.

transitions: in_flight->not_sent affirmative evidence of no effect
unknown->not_sent affirmative reconciliation of no effect
not_sent->in_flight bounded retry after current eligibility recheck

releaseGates.needed: Provider/sender/template onboarding, secret references, callback authentication and failure runbooks.
Purpose/retention/processor geography and applicable release consent policy.
Assisted lost-factor recovery remains outside this automated proof exchange; delivery facts never suffice.
